Each C# EventModel gets its own Rng seeded from the run seed + event id, and the sim already models it: Event.__init__ builds `self.event_rng` from make_event_rng(seed, ID) for string-seeded runs (events/base.py:84-88), and 6 modules branch on it. In legacy (RL) mode both are the same random.Random, so the observable is parity-only -- which is an exercised sim mode, not an unreachable one.

guards.issue: MECHANISM EV-1, one verdict at all 18 lose_hp sites (rule 3).
